lede: Buffalo Bills carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#1 in EPA per play), while Baltimore Ravens owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#18 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Buffalo Bills −9.5 with a fair total of 52.5, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Buffalo Bills pass offence vs Baltimore Ravens pass defence, which sits +0.273 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
